content: go-libp2p-pubsub gossipsub keeps one bounded outbound queue per peer: default peerOutboundQueueSize=32 messages, option WithPeerOutboundQueueSize (must be positive). Policy on overflow is DROP the new RPC, not disconnect; disconnects come from peer scoring instead. Verified from libp2p/go-libp2p-pubsub pubsub.go master (fetched directly).
